name: Sherlock
one_liner: An open-source CLI tool for finding usernames across over 400 social networks and websites.
access_note: The core CLI tool is free. Some third-party services built around Sherlock are freemium or paid.
blocker: Requires CLI execution or Python library integration, not a direct HTTP API.

evidence.quote: no account/API keys needed – Sherlock uses direct web requests and does not require creating any account or API key to use.
The core Sherlock CLI tool remains free and community-driven and using it locally keeps the search entirely under the user’s control.
Sherlock is primarily a CLI tool, so some familiarity with the command line is required to install and run it.

There is also an official Docker image available (sherlock/sherlock on Docker Hub) for containerized use, as well as community packages (e.g. in Homebrew for macOS, APT in Kali Linux, DNF in Fedora, and BlackArch).
